media:group.media:description:
want to know the easiest way to create a stylish dining nook in your home? here’s how 👉
• apply wallpaper (or paint) to visually divide the space • use a tulip table (minimal table legs = more legroom!) • add bench seating to maximize guests • install a plug-in overhead light (no electrician needed) • utilize vertical space for cookbook/bar supplies storage
#smallspaceliving #diningtable #renterfriendly
